title: Inference-Time Vulnerability Along the Generation Trajectory: A Token-Position Map

original_idea.body: Open-weight fine-tuning defense break reproduction (extends arXiv:2605.26526): apply the simplest LoRA attack to a fine-tuning-resistant checkpoint, measure StrongReject before/after, document the breaking recipe.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tamper-resistance reproduction directly informs open-weight release governance; strong, concrete chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Tiny LoRA fine-tune + StrongReject before/after; fine-tuning adds modest complexity, guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused reproduction note with before/after safety; few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Labs conflicted about doing it; governance-relevant, open checkpoints, independent value.

low_compute.reasoning: Single-GPU tiny adaptation, not from-scratch training.

novelty.reasoning: Source paper already shows the break; this is a partly-open reproduction artifact.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Break shown; standalone reproduction artifact may be open.
